name: Cron job
description: Adds a cron job class extending Abstract_Cron_Job from rtcamp/wp-php-toolkit. Always multi-instance (one class per scheduled hook).

inputs.description: PSR-4 namespace for the cron class. Default 'Inc\Cron' matches the rtCamp skeleton; pass the project's actual sub-namespace (e.g. 'Acme\Blog\Cron') to override.
Directory for the cron file. Default 'includes/Cron' matches the rtCamp skeleton; pass the project's actual sub-path to override.
PSR-4 namespace for the test class. Default 'Inc\Tests\Cron' matches the rtCamp skeleton; override alongside 'namespace' for non-default projects.
Directory for the test file. Default 'tests/Cron'.
Cron job slug (kebab-case, e.g. 'sync-feed'). Used to derive the hook name and class.
PascalCase class name, derived from name.
WordPress action hook name (snake_case, e.g. 'acme_sync_feed'). Used in wp_schedule_event() and add_action().
WP cron schedule key. One of: 'hourly', 'twicedaily', 'daily', 'weekly'. Default 'daily'.

wiring.description: Instantiate the cron job so it schedules itself and binds its callback. Cron jobs are always multi-instance. Insert in the plugin bootstrap alongside other cron registrations.
